simple.meaning: קְשׁוֹט (qᵉshôwṭ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “fidelity.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 2 times across Daniel, beginning at Daniel 2:47. Its contexts include kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קְשׁוֹט (H7187).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: קְשׁוֹט (qᵉshôwṭ) / H7187 is traced through Daniel 2:47, Daniel 4:34 as a generated source-based concept entry.
